note: Rewritten from the species description in Scheffrahn & Carrijo 2020, originally in English; the alate is a dealated specimen in the original, hence labelled dealated alate; the Diagnosis section of the original is abbreviated to a reference to the diagnoses of R. aridus and R. rufus, and the relevant comparisons have been merged into the diagnostic characters here; the text omits locality, type material, distribution, ecology and molecular analyses, and plate information is not recorded; soldier measurements follow Table 1 (8 specimens, 4 colonies) and alate measurements Table 2 (holotype only, 1 specimen, no range) of the original; the right forewing length and body length with wings columns of Table 2 are empty in the original and are not recorded; the figure numbers cited in the soldier description of the original are Fig. 7B, 7C (should be Fig. 8B, 8C), and are not cited here.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The alate head capsule is brown and the pronotum also brown; R. rufus has a red-orange head capsule and a dark brown body, and the two are separable by head colour alone. All soldier measurements are larger than in R. rufus; the platform formed by the antennal ridges on the gena is larger and only weakly rises above the frontal margin in oblique lateral view (smaller and acutely projecting in R. rufus); the third antennal segment is proportionally thicker and shorter than in R. rufus. The distinction from R. aridus is given under that species: in this species the antennal and anterolateral ridges are angular, darkly sclerotized and rugose, the head width at the antennae equals the span between the outer edges of the antennal ridges, and the outer corners of the anterolateral ridges rise above the frontal plane.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text:
(Dealated alate) Head capsule, pronotum, thorax, abdomen and wing scales uniformly chestnut brown. Compound eyes small, oval. Ocelli minute, oval, translucent, contrasting with the brown head capsule, about three-quarters of their diameter from the eye margin. Vertex and frons with more than a dozen erect setae 0.10—0.20 mm long; shallow rugae at the frontal ridges. Pronotum wider than the head capsule, anterior margin weakly concave, anterolateral corners nearly right-angled, posterior margin slightly incised medially, margins with a few long and many short setae, the interior of the surface with a few long setae. Relative lengths of the basal antennal segments 1>2<3>4. Wing scales with a few short setae. Femora pale brown, tibiae distinctly paler. Arolium present.
Measurements (mm, holotype only, n=1): maximum head width (including compound eyes) 1.21, maximum pronotum width 1.27, maximum ocellus diameter 0.07, maximum compound eye diameter 0.27, body length 7.2, antenna with at most 10 segments (broken).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Head capsule brown in dorsal view along the anteclypeal margin, the anterolateral ridges and the antennal ridges, orange from the frons to the middle of the head capsule, yellow in the posterior half; mandibles almost entirely black. In ventral view the postmentum pale orange brown, contrasting with the pale yellow head capsule. Head capsule narrow and elongate, rectangular, lateral margins very slightly convergent, with a few setae except on the occiput. Pronotum wider than long, with a few long setae on the margins and in the middle. Frontal ridges and frons forming a shallow groove, at about 40° to the plane of the vertex. In dorsal view the antennal ridges form an oval platform covering more than half of the first antennal segment; in oblique lateral view the antennal ridges project at an obtuse angle from the lower lateral frontal margin. Antennal ridges and anterolateral ridges moderately rugose, the outer edge of each ridge at about 140°. Eye spots large, narrow and oblique, only slightly paler than the head capsule. Third antennal segment almost as long as the second and fourth segments combined. Mandibles slightly shorter than half the head capsule, apex curved through about 60°, the outer edge straight in the middle of the blade, the basal swelling very shallow.
Measurements (mm, means in parentheses; n=8, 4 colonies): head length to lateral mandible base 2.32—2.88 (2.62), maximum head width 1.24—1.88 (1.54), head height including hypopharynx 1.12—1.38 (1.26), pronotum length 1.00—1.25 (1.08), pronotum width 1.50—1.90 (1.63), antenna 10—16 segments (14), third antennal segment length 0.16—0.25 (0.19).
